independent_outcomes: Merge mode refuses to ready or merge the pull request behind a "stacked" publish record, and prints a clear reason, in both real and dry runs. This is one defect with one success criterion and one new test file. Its test file is test_merge_onto_branch.py.
proposed_seams: None needed. The refusal in merge.py (_merge_one, after the pr_url check) and the edits to the third-remote tests and the merge.py comments all serve the same defect. Each one breaks or changes if you split it off, so they must ship together.

Possible later follow-up, not a split of this brief: a publish-time or schedule-time refusal for Onto branch bundles set to wave_mode = "merge". The brief already puts this out of scope, and the invariant does not need it.

Possible later follow-up, not a split of this brief: removing the third-remote fetch code that #650 added to _merge_one. The brief says this code becomes unreachable for stacked records but leaves it in place on purpose.
